newsitem.title: USA: Lawmakers to delay US bank reform session--staffer.
newsitem.headline: Lawmakers to delay US bank reform session--staffer.

text.p: House Banking Committee will delay by about a week a session scheduled for June 11 to consider bank reform legislation, committee staffers said on Thursday.

Committee chairman Jim Leach, Republican of Iowa, had said Tuesday that he hoped to draft a new bank bill for June 11 by Friday, incorporating elements of three earlier proposals and the Clinton administration's plan. But committee staffers said late on Thursday that the ambitious schedule could not be met. "We are looking at a delay of a couple of days on the bill and maybe a week on the mark up," one staff official said.
